name: Chihara Rin
source:
She is a devilish girl who pretends to be more mature than she is. She is in actuality quite shy, and is always chastised by her sister when she doesn't back up her words.

She is happy to have an older brother.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=28722]Getchu[/url]]
